featured_reviews.review_text: Beautiful and peaceful worship space! The community is warm and welcoming. Inspiring sermons and uplifting music. Highly recommend!

featured_reviews.name: nimonth prakash
featured_reviews.review_text:
Dear Brother & Sister,
If you are seeing this message it is because God wants to speak with you, God wants you to be peaceful and Happy.
Tabernacle AG Church is a very holy and peaceful place to talk to God.
After coming to this Church my Health improved dramatically, with the continuous prayer from Pastor I was relieved from stomach pain which was troubling me for 20+ years.
My Finances are getting stable.
The Pastor is blessed with holy spirit.
The Pastor is cheerful and positive to everyone.
All the Church people are good and helpful.
Do visit this Church, it will be a wonderful & spiritual experience.

featured_reviews.name: Manjiri Nadar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Please do come to Praise and worship , how we express our love, adoration, admiration, and wonder at God’s presence.
Next to the Word of God, music deserves the highest praise. The gift of language combined with the gift of song was given to man that he should proclaim the Word of God through music.
Holy and manifested place of Jesus.
One and only Lord our God who change our life inside out.
Sermons are life changing messages and has renewed my life.
I strongly urge you to visit this place on Sunday morning

featured_reviews.name: Leela Jairaj
featured_reviews.review_text:
The pastors' sermons are thought-provoking, insightful, and always leave me feeling inspired and motivated to deepen my faith. The music team is talented and leads us in worship that's both authentic and uplifting.

If you're looking for a place to connect with others, grow in your faith, and make a difference in the world, I highly recommend Tabernacle AG Church Vikhroli.

featured_reviews.name: vijoy mitra
featured_reviews.review_text: Small, simple, humble. This church doesn't thrive on massive donations. It's content with what ialt has and it makes good use of it. Many churches are money hungry and driven by power. The churches in Catholic communities are like mafias that want total control over their parishners. From their eating habits to the people they marry, the church wants it all. This church isn't like this, it's focused on the welfare of the people along with prayer and devotion to God.

For anyone who is interested should go see this church and they will love it😍.
